verse.verse_2: These are the verses of the perspicuous Book.
verse.verse_3: You may perhaps wear out your heart because they do not come to belief.
verse.verse_4: We could send down from the heavens a sign to them if We pleased, before which their heads would remain bowed.
verse.verse_5: Never does a new reminder come to them from Ar-Rahman but they turn away from it.
verse.verse_6: Surely they have done with denying; soon will come to them the news of what they were laughing at.
verse.verse_7: Do they not see the earth, how We grow all kinds of noble things upon it?
verse.verse_8: Verily there are signs in this; yet many of them do not believe.
verse.verse_9: Your Lord is surely mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_10: When your Lord called upon Moses: "Go to the wicked people,
verse.verse_11: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear and take heed?"
verse.verse_12: : He said: "O Lord, I fear that they will deny me.
verse.verse_13: My heart is constrained, my tongue falters, so delegate Aaron;
verse.verse_14: And they have a charge (of murder) against me. So I fear that they will kill me."
verse.verse_15: (It was) said: "By no means. Go with My signs, both of you. I am verily with you and I hear.
verse.verse_16: Go to the Pharaoh and tell him: 'We bring a message from the Lord of all the worlds
verse.verse_17: That you should send the children of Israel with us.'
verse.verse_18: (The Pharaoh) said: "Did we not bring you up as a child? And you lived a number of years of your life with us.
verse.verse_19: And you commited what you did, and you are ungrateful!"
verse.verse_20: (Moses) replied: "I did do that and I was in the wrong,
verse.verse_21: So I ran away from you out of fear. But my Lord has given me wisdom, and made me an apostle.
verse.verse_22: But the favour you oblige me with is that you have enslaved the children of Israel."
verse.verse_23: The Pharaoh asked: "And what is the Lord of all the worlds?"
verse.verse_24: (Moses) said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, if you can believe."
verse.verse_25: (The Pharaoh) said to those around him: "Do you hear?"
verse.verse_26: (Moses continued): "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers before you."
verse.verse_27: (The Pharaoh) said (to his nobles): "Your apostle who has been sent to you, is certainly mad."
verse.verse_28: (Moses) said: "The Lord of the East and the Lord of the West and all that lies between them, if you have sense."
verse.verse_29: (The Pharaoh) said: "If you took another god apart from me I will have you incarcerated."
verse.verse_30: (Moses) said: "Even though I have brought to you something convincing?"
verse.verse_31: (The Pharaoh) said: "Then bring it, if you speak the truth."
verse.verse_32: So (Moses) cast his staff, and lo, it turned into a living serpent.
verse.verse_33: And he drew forth his hand, and lo, it looked white to the beholders.
verse.verse_34: The Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him: "He is certainly a clever magician.
verse.verse_35: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. So, what do you bid?"
verse.verse_36: They said: "Put him and his brother off awhile, and send summoners to the cities to gather
verse.verse_37: And bring the ablest magicians to you."
verse.verse_38: So the magicians were assembled at a stated time and place on an appointed day.
verse.verse_39: And the people were also asked to assemble.
verse.verse_40: (They said): "We may haply follow the magicians if they are victorious."
verse.verse_41: When the magicians arrived, they said to the Pharaoh: "Is there a reward for us if we are victorious?" --
verse.verse_42: "Yes," he replied. "You 'will be among the honoured."
verse.verse_43: Moses said to them: "Cast what you have to cast."
verse.verse_44: So they cast their ropes and rods, and said: "By the glory of Pharaoh, we shall be victorious."
verse.verse_45: Then Moses threw down his staff, and lo, it swallowed up their conjurations.
verse.verse_46: Then the magicians fell prostrating in adoration,
verse.verse_47: And said: "We (affirm and) believe in the Lord of all the worlds,
verse.verse_48: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verse.verse_49: Said (the Pharaoh): "You have come to believe in him before I gave you leave. He is surely your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon come to know: I will have your hands and feet cut off on alternate sides, and have every one of you crucified."
verse.verse_50: They said: "There will be no harm. We shall return to our Lord.
verse.verse_51: We certainly hope our Lord will forgive our sins as we are the first to believe."
verse.verse_52: We said to Moses: "Travel by night with My creatures. You will surely be pursued."
verse.verse_53: Then the Pharaoh sent announcers to the cities,
verse.verse_54: (Proclaiming): "Surely they are a small band (of fugitives).
verse.verse_56: But we are a fully accounted army."
verse.verse_57: So We made them leave the gardens and springs of water,
verse.verse_59: Thus it was; and We made the children of Israel possess them.
verse.verse_60: But they pursued them at sunrise.
verse.verse_61: When the two forces drew within seeing distance of each other, the people of Moses said: "We shall certainly be overtaken."
verse.verse_62: Moses replied: "By no means. My Lord is with me. He will show me the way."
verse.verse_63: We commanded Moses: "Smite the sea with your staff." And it parted, and every parting was like a lofty mountain.
verse.verse_64: Then We brought the others to that place.
verse.verse_65: We delivered Moses and every one with him,
verse.verse_67: Verily there is a sign in this, but most of them do not believe.
verse.verse_68: Indeed your Lord is mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_69: Relate the news of Abraham to them.
verse.verse_70: When he asked his father and his people: "What do you worship?"
verse.verse_71: They replied: "We worship idols and are devoted to them."
verse.verse_72: (Abraham) asked: "Do they hear when you call them?
verse.verse_73: Or do they benefit you, or do you harm?"
verse.verse_74: They said: "No. But we found our fathers doing so."
verse.verse_75: He said: "Have you considered what you have been worshipping,
verse.verse_77: Yet they are my enemies except the Lord of all the worlds
verse.verse_78: Who created me and showed me the way,
verse.verse_79: Who gives me food and drink,
verse.verse_80: And heals me when I am sick,
verse.verse_81: Who will make me die, then give me life again,
verse.verse_82: And who, I hope, will condone my faults on the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_83: O Lord, give me wisdom and admit me among the righteous,
verse.verse_84: And uphold my name with posterity,
verse.verse_85: And put me among the inheritors of Paradise.
verse.verse_86: Forgive me and my father: He was surely among those who went astray.
verse.verse_87: And do not disgrace me on the day when they are raised from the graves,
verse.verse_88: The day when neither wealth nor children will be of any avail
verse.verse_89: But to him who comes to God with a tranquil heart."
verse.verse_90: Paradise will be brought near those who take heed for themselves and follow the straight path;
verse.verse_91: And Hell made visible to those who had gone astray.
verse.verse_92: They will be asked: "Where are those you worshipped
verse.verse_93: Other than God? Can they save you or even save themselves?"
verse.verse_94: They will then be thrown into Hell with those who had gone astray
verse.verse_95: Together with the hordes of Iblis.
verse.verse_96: Disputing among themselves they will say:
verse.verse_97: "By God, we were plainly in error
verse.verse_98: In equating you with the Lord of all the worlds;
verse.verse_99: No one but the sinners led us astray.
verse.verse_100: Now we have none to intercede for us,
verse.verse_102: If only we could return and be among the believers!"
verse.verse_103: Verily there is a sign in this, but many of them do not believe.
verse.verse_104: Verily your Lord is mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_105: The people of Noah accused the apostles of lies.
verse.verse_106: When their brother Noah said to them: "Will you not take heed?
verse.verse_107: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
verse.verse_108: So be fearful of God and listen to me.
verse.verse_109: I ask no recompense of you for it. My reward is due from none but the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_110: So fear God and follow me."
verse.verse_111: They said: "Should we place our trust in you when only the condemned follow you?"
verse.verse_112: He said: "It is not for me to know what they were doing.
verse.verse_113: It is for my Lord to bring them to book, if you can understand.
verse.verse_114: I am certainly not one to drive away the believers.
verse.verse_115: I am only a plain admonisher."
verse.verse_116: They said: "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will be stoned to death."
verse.verse_117: He prayed: "O Lord, verily my people accuse me of lies.
verse.verse_118: So adjudge between me and them conclusively, and save me and the believers who are with me."
verse.verse_119: So We delivered him and those with him in the loaded ark,
verse.verse_120: And drowned the rest of them.
verse.verse_121: Verily there is a sign in this, yet many of them do not believe.
verse.verse_122: But surely your Lord is mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_123: The people of 'Ad accused the messengers of lies.
verse.verse_124: When their brother Hud said to them: "Will you not take heed?
verse.verse_125: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
verse.verse_126: So fear God and listen to me.
verse.verse_127: I ask no recompense of you for it. My reward is due from none but the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_128: You construct monuments on every hill in vain,
verse.verse_129: Erect palaces (thinking) that you will live for ever,
verse.verse_130: And whenever you apply force become tyrannical.
verse.verse_131: So be fearful of God and follow me.
verse.verse_132: Fear Him who has bestowed on you what you know,
verse.verse_133: Gave you increase of cattle and sons,
verse.verse_135: I fear the punishment of a terrible day for you.
verse.verse_136: They said: "It is the same to us if you warn us or do not warn.
verse.verse_137: This is just a habit of antiquated people.
verse.verse_138: We are not going to be damned."
verse.verse_139: Then they accused him of lies; so We annihilated them. Verily there is a sign in this, but most of them do not believe.
verse.verse_140: Yet surely your Lord is mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_141: The Thamud accused the messengers of lies.
verse.verse_142: When their brother Saleh said to them: "Will you not take heed?"
verse.verse_143: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
verse.verse_144: So fear God and follow me.
verse.verse_145: I do not ask any recompense of you for this. My reward is due from none but the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_146: (Do you think) you will be left secure here
verse.verse_147: In these gardens and these springs,
verse.verse_148: The fields of corn and date-palm trees with soft and tender spathes,
verse.verse_149: And dwellings hewed out of mountains ingeniously?
verse.verse_150: So be mindful of God and listen to me.
verse.verse_151: Do not follow those who are extravagant,
verse.verse_152: Who corrupt the land and do not reform it."
verse.verse_154: You are nothing but a man like us. Bring us a token if you speak the truth."
verse.verse_155: (Saleh) said: "Here is a she-camel. She has a right of drinking water, and you have a right of drinking it on appointed turns.
verse.verse_156: Do not treat her unkindly or the punishment of a grievous day will fall on you."
verse.verse_157: But they hamstrung her; and on the morrow were repentant,
verse.verse_158: For they were seized by the torment. Verily there was a sign in this, but most of them did not believe.
verse.verse_159: Yet verily your Lord is mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_160: The people of Lot accused the messengers of lies.
verse.verse_161: When their brother Lot said to them: "Will you not take heed?
verse.verse_162: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
verse.verse_163: So fear God and listen to me.
verse.verse_164: I ask no recompense of you for this. My reward is due from none but the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_165: Why do you go for males unlike all other creatures
verse.verse_166: Leaving the consorts your Lord has made for you? But you are a people who exceed the bounds."
verse.verse_167: They said: "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will be expelled (from the city)."
verse.verse_168: (Lot) said: "I am disgusted with your actions,"
verse.verse_169: (And prayed:) "O Lord, save me and my family from what they do."
verse.verse_170: So We saved him and his whole family
verse.verse_171: Except one old woman who remained behind.
verse.verse_172: Then We destroyed the rest of them,
verse.verse_173: And rained on them a shower (of Stones). How terrible was the rain (that fell) on those who had been warned!
verse.verse_174: Verily in this was a sign, but most of them do not believe.
verse.verse_175: Yet surely your Lord is mighty and powerful.
verse.verse_176: The people of the Wood too called the messengers liars.
verse.verse_177: When Shu'aib said to them: "Will you not take heed?
verse.verse_178: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
verse.verse_179: So fear God and follow me.
verse.verse_180: I ask no recompense of you for this. My reward is due from none but the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_181: Give full measure and do not cheat;
verse.verse_183: And do not withhold from people what belongs to them, and do not corrupt the land;
verse.verse_184: And fear Him who created you and all the earlier people."
verse.verse_186: You are nothing but a man like us, and we think you are a liar.
verse.verse_187: But in case you are speaking the truth, then make a segment of the sky to fall upon us."
verse.verse_188: (Shu'aib) said: "My Lord knows well what you are doing."
verse.verse_189: But they denied him, and We seized them with the torment of the Day of Shadowing (when the cloud had rained down fire). It was indeed the torment of a terrible day!
verse.verse_190: Verily in this was a sign, but most of them do not believe.
verse.verse_191: Yet verily your Lord is mighty and merciful.
verse.verse_192: And this (Qur'an) is a revelation from the Lord of all the worlds,
verse.verse_193: Which the trusted spirit descended with
verse.verse_194: To (communicate) to your heart that you may be a warner
verse.verse_196: This is (indicated) in the Books of earlier people.
verse.verse_197: Was it not a proof for them that the learned men of Israel knew about this?
verse.verse_198: Had We revealed it to a man of obscure tongue
verse.verse_199: And he had recited it to them, and they had not believed (it would have been different).
verse.verse_200: Thus do We cause (unbelief) to enter the hearts of sinners.
verse.verse_201: They will not believe it until they behold the painful punishment.
verse.verse_202: It will come upon them unawares, and they will not comprehend it.
verse.verse_203: Then will they say: "Can we be given respite?"
verse.verse_204: Do they wish Us then to hasten the punishment?
verse.verse_205: Just think: If We let them enjoy (the good things of life) for a few years more,
verse.verse_206: And then what they were promised comes upon them,
verse.verse_207: Of what avail shall their enjoyment be to them?
verse.verse_208: Never have We destroyed a habitation till We had sent admonishers to them
verse.verse_209: To warn. For We are never unjust.
verse.verse_210: The devils did not bring it down:
verse.verse_211: They are not worthy of it, nor have they power.
verse.verse_212: They have been precluded from hearing it.
verse.verse_213: So call on no other god but God, lest you are condemned to torment;
verse.verse_215: And take those believers under your wing who follow you.
verse.verse_216: If they do not obey you, tell them: "I am not responsible for what you do."
verse.verse_217: Have trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,
verse.verse_218: Who watches you when you get up,
verse.verse_219: And your movements among those who bow in homage to God.
verse.verse_221: Should I tell you on whom the devils descend?
verse.verse_222: They come down to every mendacious sinner,
verse.verse_223: Who listens to you (for spreading rumours); but most of them are liars.
verse.verse_224: As for the poets, only those who go astray follow them.
verse.verse_225: Have you not seen that they wander distract in every valley,
verse.verse_226: And they say what they do not do,
verse.verse_227: Except those who believe and do the right, and remember God a great deal, who retaliate only when they have been wronged. Yet the oppressors will now come to know through what reversals they will be overthrown!
